issues: The [fanfare] cost is mandatory, not optional. Replace the optionalCost wrapper with a fanfare ability that requires banishing 2 amulets from your cemetery as an additional cost before resolving the effect; this needs engine support for mandatory non-activated additional costs on triggered abilities.

The [fanfare] first effect should banish 2 amulets from your cemetery, but the cost filter uses {"cardType":"amulet"} in banishFromCemetery, and cemetery banish filters use DeckFilter fields that do not list cardType behavior for cemetery cards clearly; if unsupported, add engine support for cemetery filtering by card type/amulet.

The [act] ability's cost is encoded incorrectly as mill 1. It should bury an amulet from your field/cost area as the activation cost; encode it with an activated cost that buries a matching amulet from your field, which requires engine support for activated cost filtering to bury a specific amulet card from the field.
The [act] ability incorrectly summons from the deck using searchDeckChoose. It should let you optionally summon a Havencraft follower or amulet that costs 3 or less from your hand onto your field.
The [act] ability filter is incomplete. It should restrict to Havencraft follower or amulet cards costing 3 or less from your hand, not any Havencraft card costing 3 or less from the deck.
The parsed card has keywords ["activated"] and ["fanfare"]. Activated is not a card keyword and should not appear in keywords; keep the [act] text as an ability only.

The On Evolve buff is encoded incorrectly as buffFieldTrait with cardClass "haven". It should give each other follower on your field +0/+2 regardless of class; encode a field-wide ally-follower buff excluding self instead of restricting to Havencraft followers.

The cemetery condition is encoded incorrectly as ownCemeteryMin 2. It should check for at least 2 followers with "Jeanne" in their name in your cemetery; add engine support for cemetery name-contains or identityNameContains counting conditions, then use that condition for both the buff and Storm grant.

The Strike ability incorrectly targets a selfFollower with excludeSelf true. The source says "Select a Havencraft follower that costs 2 or less on your field," which may include this follower if it matches; remove excludeSelf.

The Strike target restriction is encoded with an unsupported nested targets.filter. Encode the target using supported target selector fields or an effect/filter structure that correctly restricts to a Havencraft follower on your field that costs 2 or less.

The [fanfare] life payment is mandatory, not optional. Replace optionalCost with a mandatory additional cost/effect sequence that reduces your leader's defense by 2 before destroying the target; this needs engine support for mandatory negative leader-defense payment on triggered abilities.

The cost is encoded as healLeader amount -2, which is not a defined or reliable way to represent "Give your leader [defense]-2." Add an implemented operation for leader self-damage or leader defense loss, then use it here.

The play-cost reduction ability is encoded as an activated ability with condition enteredFromHand, but the source text is a "When playing this card" additional cost/reduction effect. Encode it as a play-time cost reduction effect tied to playing this card, not as a separate activated ability; this needs engine support for conditional additional costs while playing a card.

The additional cost should bury exactly one Levin follower that costs 3 or less, but the encoding uses buryFieldFollowers with an unsupported count field and a mass-bury style operation. Add engine support for selecting and burying one matching follower from your field as a play-time additional cost.

The card is missing the actual play-cost reduction semantics while in hand/play process. playCostReduction inside an activated ability does not faithfully represent "This card costs 3 less to play" when the cost is paid during playing; add engine support for conditional self play-cost reduction linked to an optional play-time cost.

The onDiscard ability is encoded as searchDeckChoose lookAt 1 to hand, but the source specifically says look at the top card of your deck, and if it's a Levin card, you may reveal it and add it to your hand. This needs a top-deck peek/reveal-if-matches/add-to-hand encoding; add engine support for peeking at the top card and conditionally moving it to hand with reveal.

The passive Storm ability is encoded as grantKeyword under timing passive. Since the source says "this has Storm" while a condition holds, encode Storm as a passive keyword/aura under the cemetery condition rather than a granted trigger effect.
